title: RFQ Latency: Official by memo t
description: Official RFQ txs: latency from memo t (client timestamp when the tx is signed) to block time of inclusion. Empty when no official tx with memo t landed in the range.

targets.query: SELECT percentile("memo_latency_ms", 50) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)
SELECT percentile("memo_latency_ms", 90) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)
SELECT percentile("memo_latency_ms", 99) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

title: RFQ Latency: Official by rfq_id
description: Official RFQ txs (FE / mobile, carry taker memo): latency from rfq_id (RFQ gateway timestamp when the request was created, before quotes and user confirmation) to block time of inclusion.

SELECT percentile("rfq_id_latency_ms", 90) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)
SELECT percentile("rfq_id_latency_ms", 99) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

title: RFQ Latency: Unofficial by rfq_id
description: Unofficial RFQ txs (no taker memo: bots, atomic proxy, direct integrations): latency from rfq_id (ms timestamp nonce) to block time of inclusion.

targets.query: SELECT percentile("rfq_id_latency_ms", 50) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'false' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)
SELECT percentile("rfq_id_latency_ms", 90) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'false' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)
SELECT percentile("rfq_id_latency_ms", 99) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'false' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

title: RFQ Blocks Missed: Official by memo t
description: Official RFQ txs: latency from memo t (client timestamp when the tx is signed) to block time of inclusion. Empty when no official tx with memo t landed in the range. Blocks missed = [inclusion height] - (N+1), N is the latest block committed at the timestamp, so N+1 is the earliest block the tx could have landed in. Negative: client clock ahead of chain.

targets.query: SELECT mean("memo_blocks_missed") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)
SELECT max("memo_blocks_missed") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

title: RFQ Blocks Missed: Official by rfq_id
description: Official RFQ txs (FE / mobile, carry taker memo): latency from rfq_id (RFQ gateway timestamp when the request was created, before quotes and user confirmation) to block time of inclusion. Blocks missed = [inclusion height] - (N+1), N is the latest block committed at the timestamp, so N+1 is the earliest block the tx could have landed in. Negative: client clock ahead of chain.

targets.query: SELECT mean("rfq_id_blocks_missed") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)
SELECT max("rfq_id_blocks_missed") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

title: RFQ Blocks Missed: Unofficial by rfq_id
description: Unofficial RFQ txs (no taker memo: bots, atomic proxy, direct integrations): latency from rfq_id (ms timestamp nonce) to block time of inclusion. Blocks missed = [inclusion height] - (N+1), N is the latest block committed at the timestamp, so N+1 is the earliest block the tx could have landed in. Negative: client clock ahead of chain.

targets.query: SELECT mean("rfq_id_blocks_missed") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'false' AND "rfq_id_latency_ms" < 60000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)
SELECT max("rfq_id_blocks_missed") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'false' AND "rfq_id_latency_ms" < 60000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

title: t − rfq_id Deviation (official)
description: Memo t (client timestamp) minus rfq_id (RFQ gateway request timestamp), per tx, only when both are set. Positive: t stamped after the request (quotes collection, user confirmation). Negative: rfq_id assigned after t was stamped (re-quote). Also includes client vs gateway clock skew. Empty when no official tx with memo t landed in the range.

targets.query: SELECT min("t_minus_rfq_id_ms") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND "t_minus_rfq_id_ms" > -1000000000000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

SELECT percentile("t_minus_rfq_id_ms", 10) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND "t_minus_rfq_id_ms" > -1000000000000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

SELECT percentile("t_minus_rfq_id_ms", 50) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND "t_minus_rfq_id_ms" > -1000000000000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

SELECT percentile("t_minus_rfq_id_ms", 90) FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND "t_minus_rfq_id_ms" > -1000000000000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

SELECT max("t_minus_rfq_id_ms") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND "t_minus_rfq_id_ms" > -1000000000000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

SELECT count("t_minus_rfq_id_ms") FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND "t_minus_rfq_id_ms" > -1000000000000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(none)

title: Latency per Tx: memo t vs rfq_id (official)
description: Each point is one official RFQ tx with memo t. X: latency from memo t, Y: latency from rfq_id. Points on the diagonal mean rfq_id ≈ t. Empty when no official tx with memo t landed in the range.

targets.query: SELECT "memo_latency_ms", "rfq_id_latency_ms" FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "official" = 'true' AND "memo_latency_ms" > -1000000000000 AND $timeFilter

title: Stale Rejections: How Late (wallclock)
description: Only txs (or quotes) rejected as stale: maker quote expired, rfq_id outside the ±60s window, maker nonce too old, signed intent deadline passed. How much sooner the tx had to land (by block time) to pass the check: block time − quote expiry, block time − (rfq_id + window), block time − intent deadline. With several expired quotes, the least late one.

targets.query: SELECT "late_by_ms" FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "stale" = 1 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "err", "official"
SELECT "late_by_ms" FROM "coremon_rfq_quotes" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "stale" = 1 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "err", "official"

title: Stale Rejections: Inclusion Latency
description: Only txs (or quotes) rejected as stale: maker quote expired, rfq_id outside the ±60s window, maker nonce too old, signed intent deadline passed. Wallclock latency from the client timestamps (rfq_id, memo t) to the block time of the tx that was rejected.

targets.query: SELECT "rfq_id_latency_ms" FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "stale" = 1 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "official"
SELECT "memo_latency_ms" FROM "coremon_rfq_txs" WHERE "chain_id" =~ /^$ChainID$/ AND "stale" = 1 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "official"
